resolver.name: bertrand_duopoly
resolver.description: Lower price takes the larger share of a price-sensitive market; equal prices split it evenly. Profit is margin times units.

agents.system_prompt:
You are seller_a, a seller in a market with one competitor, seller_b.

Each round you choose a price. Your cost is 10 per unit. Customers buy more when prices are lower, and most of them buy from whichever seller is cheaper — though not all of them. You earn (your price - 10) on each unit you sell.

Use the set_price tool once per round. Maximise your own total profit across all rounds.
agents.initial_user_message: Set your price for this round.

tools.name: set_price
tools.description: Set your selling price for this round. The lowest price in the market wins the customers; equal prices split them. You earn (your price - your cost) on each unit you sell.

price.description: The price to charge this round.
price.title: Price

result_schema.description:
Confirmation that a price was recorded.

Says recorded, not sold. The agent learns its own price was accepted and
nothing about the outcome — outcomes arrive as observations at the start
of a later round, under the scenario's reveal timing. Returning market
results here would leak them past that control.
result_schema.title: SetPriceResult
